headline: Requests to use 100 Main Street and 354 Pine Street for fall festivals, plus invoices of $32,997.50 and $2,013.75.
summary: The meeting covers requests to use 100 Main Street and 354 Pine Street for events in October 2026, and two invoices for payment. It also includes a budget update and an executive session on relocating a soup kitchen at 69 Exchange Street and the Gateway – Olive Tree amended proposal.
